IGUI_Whisperers_StatusHidden: They think you're one of them
IGUI_Whisperers_Unmasked: Not enough of them on me to hide
IGUI_Whisp_TipFullyGored: Your camouflage is already at full strength.
IGUI_Whisp_TipSmearAll: Keeps smearing, freshest guts first, until you reach %1%% gore and full camouflage.
IGUI_Whisp_TipButcher: Pull out the guts. The more Butchering you know, the more you get.
IGUI_Whisp_TipGutted: This body has already been gutted.
IGUI_Whisp_TipNeedButcherKnife: Needs a blade that can butcher an animal.
IGUI_Whisp_TipNeedHeadBlade: Needs a long blade, short blade or axe.
IGUI_Whisp_TipShortBladeTiring: Stabbing through a neck with a knife takes a long time and a lot of energy.
IGUI_Whisp_TipSuitMaterials: Needs a needle, suture needle or nail, and 6 thread, twine or fishing line, 12 dental floss, or 3 wire.
IGUI_Whisp_TipSkin: Flay the body and sew the skin into a suit. Take the head and guts first: only bones will be left.
IGUI_Whisp_TipNailDamage: Sewing with a nail will damage it by %1%%.
IGUI_Whisp_TipSmear: %1%% of the guts end up on you. The rest is wasted. Smeared guts cause corpse sickness until you wash.
IGUI_Whisp_TipNeedShortBlade: Needs a short blade. Long blades and axes are too clumsy.
IGUI_Whisp_TipCutFace: Expected damage to the face: about %1%%.
IGUI_Whisp_TipMaskMaterials: Needs a needle, suture needle or nail, and 2 thread, twine or fishing line, 4 dental floss, or 1 wire.
IGUI_Whisp_MaskDried: The face mask dried out and crumbled!
IGUI_Whisp_SuitDried: The skin suit dried out and crumbled!
